in_marathi.name: Manab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Mind, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manab is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘manas’, meaning ‘mind’. This name signifies one who possesses a great intellect and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Manab is associated with Lord Shiva, who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
